exact_active_reference_variants.review: Purified active Hyd1ABC mapped to Swol_1017 (SWOL_RS05165). Exact protein sequence only: CpI C300 maps to Ser299, other three H-cluster Cys remain. Does not establish that Ser ligates the cluster; no general Cys->Ser acceptance rule.

scope: Four protein ligands to NiFe; four protein ligands of FeFe H-cluster cubane including the bridge to 2Fe; single protein ligand to Hmd FeGP. Organic/non-protein ligands and query occupancy are not inferred. Sequence windows are reviewed active-center spans, not universal H-domain boundary predictions. Neighbor substitutions are reported individually, not blanket evidence of inactivity; Hmd His14 signature is canonical-mechanism evidence only. Cys/Sec variants in NiFe are accepted as sequence-compatible, including computational N-terminal Sec candidates, without claiming experimental validation. Required ligand/reaction-signature positions each require +/-15 reference residues (clipped to reviewed model boundaries) with >=0.8 observed coverage and >=25% identity. These are provisional alignment-quality settings, not biochemical functional boundaries. Full template span coverage is still reported; catalytic-domain integrity is not established by this site mapper.
